notes.title: Turkish Translation Update!
notes.content: [p]Dear players from Turkey, I am pleased to present to you an improved version of the Turkish localization. I have heard rumors about improper and, in places, offensive localization. One community member([url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/sayinnn"]sayinnn[/url]) expressed his desire to help. Thanks to his efforts, the game has an updated localization. Thank him very much![/p][p]Please, if you check it out, let me know about the quality of the new localization. Thank you![/p][p]I used Google Translate online for this message, so forgive any mistakes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470928/8a2281457068103af08f050606d816612a027064.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Now everything is according to the law!
notes.content: [p]Hello. Hard times have come. I woke up this morning to find Steam removing a bunch of games from the store without prior notice.[/p][p]I don't want the same fate for Family Crush, so I urgently released a patch now, replacing the line at the end, so that everything is legal.[/p][p]Why did this happen now? I don't know. Previously, there was a policy - as long as no one complains, then it's okay. Apparently, someone started complaining. And even now, since the theme of my game is completely legal, maybe Valve will decide to remove my game from the store just because of the name. But I have no intention of changing the name.[/p][p]Hard times have come for all of us, and I can't say whether it will get worse. Anything is possible. I'm sorry if such actions on my part (changing the plot for the sake of compliance with the law) could upset anyone. You can keep the original plot in mind, and if this is unacceptable for you, then feel free to apply for a refund. Forgive me. Let's hope for the best.[/p]

notes.title: PORTUGUESE BRAZILIAN IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[p]A couple of weeks ago, a guy named Marcos contacted me. He really liked the game, with one exception. The game didn't have his native language, Portuguese Brazilian. So he offered to translate Family Crush into Portuguese Brazilian for free. Two weeks later, Marcos and I are happy to present the translation into Portuguese Brazilian. 

Once again, a big thank you to Marcos for his translation, without him, this wouldn't have happened. For everyone who's been waiting for this language to appear, now's the time to check it out! And if you don't mind, feel free to leave a review![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470928/c39c0daa351ba3a9c95252f06746fa3ffbd7bc91.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: FAMILY CRUSH IS OUT!
notes.content:
I want to express my heartfelt thanks to all of you for your support and interest in my game. As with my previous project, Summer Crush, I worked on this project alone (though I commissioned music and animations from friends). Creating games—or visual novels, if you will—isn't easy. Constant stress, fear, and hundreds of sleepless nights... But you've seen it all yourselves! Don't get me wrong—I chose this path myself, and all the negative aspects came hand in hand with the passion and obsession to create something beautiful. I didn't make Family Crush just to earn money and ride off into the sunset in a brand-new sports car. I hope you'll notice that.

Enjoy the game, and I hope it leaves a lasting impression.

[b]Important note:[/b] If you're planning to play in Simplified Chinese or Turkish, please note that after selecting the language icon (bottom right corner) in the main menu, the game needs to be restarted so the engine can properly reload the font library!

Questions about cards, backgrounds, and so on will be clarified during the first week of sales. In other words, if sales are adequate, Valve will allow me to release all these features.

I have just one request: please leave a review on Steam if it's not too much trouble!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470928/073e1d3d4393785bf9fa1c57c4a984625b1e1ddf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Not today, guys.
notes.content:
It's May 22nd and it was supposed to be Family Crush's release day, however, the game is still being checked out by Steam support. How long it will take to check out I don't know. The reason for the longer check? Hanna (she's in the screenshot). [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470928/b1b6fd60a08c3e10e18b8a9d2fa85125f6b7a4a7.jpg[/img]

Support apparently had questions regarding her age. It was mentioned several times in the story that she is the “younger” sister. Apparently, she has reached adulthood and Valve employees need more time to verify this. Unfortunately, I am powerless to speed up the process in any way. All that remains is to humbly await approval.

Hopefully by next week the situation will be clearer. After all, the game is ready and I can't wait to share the result of my labors. Thank you for waiting.
